{'text': 'Apple 今日開始銷售 iPhone 18 Pro 及 iPhone 18 Pro Max、M5 Max 及 M5 Ultra Mac Studio，以及 M6 或 M5 Pro Mac mini 型號的維修零件。詳情如下。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple today began selling repair parts for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max, as well as the M5 Max and M5 Ultra Mac Studio and the M6 or M5 Pro Mac mini models. Here are the details.'}

{'text': '新款 iPhone 與 Mac 的零件及工具現已開售', 'paragraph_context': 'Parts and tools now available for new iPhones and Macs'}

{'text': 'Apple 於 2022 年推出自助維修計劃，允許符合資格地區的用戶購買替換零件，以及購買或租賃自行維修支援裝置所需的工具。', 'paragraph_context': 'Apple launched its Self Service Repair program in 2022, allowing users in eligible regions to purchase replacement parts and buy or rent the tools needed to perform their own repairs on supported devices.'}

{'text': '此外，Apple 亦為多款產品提供官方維修手冊，內含每個可維修零件或組件替換程序的詳細逐步指引。', 'paragraph_context': 'Additionally, Apple offers official repair manuals for several products, with detailed, step-by-step instructions on the replacement procedures for each serviceable part or component.'}

{'text': 'Apple 今日將自助維修商店擴展至涵蓋多款近期推出的裝置，提供替換零件及工具。是次更新與 Apple 宣佈與美國供應商建立新合作及擴大合作關係、生產 iPhone 18 Pro 及 iPhone Duo 組件於同一天公佈。', 'paragraph_context': 'Today, Apple expanded the Self Service Repair Store to include replacement parts and tools for several recently released devices. The update comes on the same day that Apple announced new and expanded partnerships with US suppliers producing components for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Duo.'}

{'text': '對 iPhone 18 Pro 及 iPhone 18 Pro Max 用戶而言，這代表他們現在可以購買以下組件的替換零件及工具：', 'paragraph_context': 'For iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max owners, this means they can now purchase replacement parts and tools for the following components:'}

  • {'text': '背蓋玻璃', 'paragraph_context': 'Back glass'}
  • {'text': '電池', 'paragraph_context': 'Battery'}
  • {'text': '底部喇叭', 'paragraph_context': 'Bottom speaker'}
  • {'text': '相機', 'paragraph_context': 'Camera'}
  • {'text': '顯示器', 'paragraph_context': 'Display'}
  • {'text': '外殼', 'paragraph_context': 'Enclosure'}
  • {'text': '前置相機', 'paragraph_context': 'Front camera'}
  • {'text': '主機板', 'paragraph_context': 'Logic board'}
  • {'text': '主麥克風', 'paragraph_context': 'Main microphone'}
  • {'text': '其他零件', 'paragraph_context': 'Other parts'}
  • {'text': 'SIM 卡托', 'paragraph_context': 'SIM tray'}
  • {'text': 'Taptic Engine', 'paragraph_context': 'Taptic Engine'}
  • {'text': '頂部喇叭', 'paragraph_context': 'Top speaker'}

{'text': '選擇類別後，頁面會顯示可用的替換零件，以及維修程序所需的工具和其他耗材，例如黏合劑切割器、吸盤、尼龍探針、除膠工具、扭力螺絲批及螺絲。這些物品亦可分開購買。', 'paragraph_context': 'Selecting a category brings up the available replacement parts, along with tools and other supplies needed for the procedure, such as adhesive cutters, suction cups, nylon probes, adhesive removal tools, torque drivers, and screws. These items can also be purchased separately.'}

{'text': '供好奇心旺盛的朋友參考，替換相機的售價為 249 美元，與去年的型號相同，儘管 iPhone 18 Pro 及 Pro Max 新增了可變光圈系統。Apple 亦提供 59.76 美元的折讓 crédit，用於回收原裝相機，使實際費用降至 189.24 美元。', 'paragraph_context': 'For those who are curious, the replacement camera costs $249, unchanged from last year’s models, despite the addition of a new variable-aperture system to the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max. Apple also offers a $59.76 credit for returning the original camera, bringing the effective cost down to $189.24.'}

{'text': 'Mac Studio（M5 Max 及 M5 Ultra）方面，Apple 現在提供從 Thunderbolt 及 USB-C 端口，到風扇、喇叭、SSD 模組、主機板及電源供應器等所有零件的替換。', 'paragraph_context': 'For the Mac Studio (M5 Max and M5 Ultra), Apple now offers replacement parts for everything from Thunderbolt and USB-C ports to fans, speakers, SSD modules, logic boards, and power supplies.'}

{'text': 'Mac mini（M6 及 M5 Pro）的替換零件清單則相對較短，涵蓋風扇、喇叭、主機板、電池及電源供應器等組件。', 'paragraph_context': 'The Mac mini (M6 and M5 Pro) has a somewhat shorter list, covering components such as fans, speakers, logic boards, batteries, and power supplies, among others.'}
